{{Quote|I think we can forgive you this time, Hoole. Give Rikki a scratch behind the ears and I'm sure he'll forgive you, too.|Codru-Ji governor|<ref name="EGTAS" />}}
A [[Codru-Ji]] '''governor''' invited [[Senior Anthropologist]] [[Mammon Hoole]] to dinner at their home. When Hoole arrived, the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] and his [[Unidentified Codru-Ji governor's mate|mate]] greeted their guest warmly. However, the governor's [[wyrwulf]] son, [[Rikki]], pounced on Hoole and knocked him to the ground. Hoole reacted instinctively and called Rikki a "mangy beast," causing Rikki to jump off and start whining. The governor told Hoole that his son was not a mangy beast and Hoole immediately apologized, using a customary Codru-Ji  gesture. The governor accepted Hoole's apology, advising Hoole to give Rikki a scratch behind the ears so that his son was forgive him as well. Hoole did as the governor advised, and Rikki licked Hoole's fingers in response. The two proceeded with their meeting, although the governor's mate was noticeably cooler towards Hoole.<ref name="EGTAS" />
